personality_one_liner: An enterprise-grade hybrid of Apple's elegance and Notion's clarity, focused on extreme legibility, high trust, and effortless retail management.

spacing.rule: Use Apple-native inset-grouped spacing. 16px horizontal margins for lists, 12px gap in grids. No tight clustering.

do's: Sticky bottom CTA bar in the Billing screen
Floating Action Button background (blur over surface)

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A premium overview of today's business metrics, cash flow, and quick actions.

states.error: Failed to load dashboard data + Retry CTA

screens.layout: Apple-style large title header. A hero card for 'Today's Sales' using brandPrimary background or gradient. A 2-column grid for KPIs (Profit, Expenses, Cash, Inv Value). A horizontally scrolling section for Quick Actions (Add Bill, Add Expense). A recent activity Apple-style inset list at the bottom.

screens.name: Inventory
screens.purpose: Manage product catalog, check stock levels, and organize categories.

states.empty: Illustration of empty shelves + 'Add your first product' CTA
states.error: Failed to load inventory + Retry CTA

screens.layout: Sticky header with a search bar and category pills (scrollable horizontally). An inset-grouped list of products showing a thumbnail (use product_placeholder image), Title, SKU, Price (INR), and a Stock pill (red if low). FAB to 'Add Product'.

screens.name: Parties
screens.purpose: Manage Customers and Suppliers ledgers, view outstandings, and quick-call/WhatsApp them.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty address book + 'Add new party' CTA
states.error: Failed to load parties + Retry CTA

screens.layout: Top segmented control (Customers | Suppliers). Apple-style inset list of parties. Each row shows Name, Contact, and Outstanding Balance in green/red. Right accessory is a quick WhatsApp/Call icon button.

screens.name: Billing (POS)
screens.purpose: Quick, highly efficient GST invoice generation with a sticky checkout bar.

states.error: Failed to process bill + Retry CTA

screens.layout: Form layout with inset grouped sections. Section 1: Customer Selection (dropdown/search). Section 2: Line Items (swipe-to-delete rows). Big 'Add Item' button. Sticky bottom container (glassmorphism) showing Total Amount, Tax breakdown, and a primary 'Generate Invoice' button.

product_placeholder.alt: White and gray curtain fabric texture

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality strictly. The UI should resemble native Apple apps (like Settings or Health) mixed with Notion's clarity.
Typography rule: Max font weight is 500. Never use bold, semibold, or black. Create hierarchy purely through font size and color (primary vs secondary text).
Use inset-grouped lists for data rows (like Inventory items, Ledger parties, Billing line items). Use surfaceSecondary as the background for these cards with an md radius.
NEVER use blue, purple, or indigo. The brand accent is a deep moss green (#274A3D) to signify wealth and physical retail goods. Fallback to dark grey/near-black for primary buttons if needed.
For the Dashboard, group KPIs in a 2-column grid. Ensure numeric values use the Indian numbering system (e.g., INR 1,50,000) and are highly legible.
Implement a persistent FAB over the bottom tabs for 'Quick Add'. It should open an Action Sheet (or bottom sheet) with options: New Invoice, New Product, New Expense.

For the POS/Billing screen, implement a sticky bottom container using glassmorphism. This container must house the 'Total Amount' and the primary 'Generate Invoice' button, remaining visible above the keyboard and safe area.
All text overlays on background images (e.g., hero cards or empty states) MUST use a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG AA readability.
Use Phosphor icons. Stick to regular weight, max size 24px for standard UI elements.

Do not use generic Material Design shadows. Shadow tier 1 means only very subtle elevation on floating elements (FAB, Modals). Standard cards should rely on border or surfaceSecondary background for distinction.
